rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion narrow and coalition-holding: "relating to" makes §1101(a)(43)(S) broad enough to cover intentional hindrance of apprehension or punishment without requiring a pending proceeding, while reserving outer limits. Separate writings are most likely from Gorsuch/Thomas (textual/originalist gloss) and from Sotomayor/Barrett/Jackson (term-of-art anchor plus Fong Haw Tan/lenity-based dissent).
